feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Poundland owner turns to Thames Water creditors' lobbying firm as political heat rises
articles.summary: The embattled owner of Poundland has parachuted in a team of top London lobbyists as it faces intensifying political pressure over the discount retailer's fate.

articles.title: Third person charged after police officer shot in foot in Nottingham
articles.summary: A 31-year-old woman has become the third person to be charged after a police officer was shot in the foot at a bus stop in Nottingham city centre.

articles.title: Almost 75% of Britons view US as serious threat to global peace
articles.summary: Almost three-quarters of Britons believe the US to be a serious threat to global peace - more than double the figure from two years ago - according to a new survey.

articles.title: UK agrees to 'time-bound' talks on harms of slave trade
articles.summary: The UK has agreed to engage in "structured, time-bound, inclusive and good-faith" talks that address the "historical harms" of the transatlantic slave trade, Commonwealth leaders have said.

articles.title: Three men arrested after suspected murder of non-league footballer
articles.summary: Three men have been arrested after the death of a "talented" and "inspirational" non-league footballer.

articles.title: Health checks offered to residents near one of England's worst illegal waste sites
articles.summary: Dedicated health checks, including asthma and blood pressure assessments, are being offered to people living near one of England's worst illegal waste sites.

articles.title: Just 13% of UK teenage girls active every day, WHO figures show
articles.summary: Experts have warned that more needs to be done to boost the exercise levels of UK teenagers - with just 13% of teenage girls active every day.

articles.title: Tributes paid to celebrity hairstylist John Frieda who has died aged 75
articles.summary: Tributes have been paid to British celebrity hairstylist and beauty brand entrepreneur John Frieda who has died aged 75.

articles.title: Blood tests that could spot early signs of cancers to be trialled on thousands of NHS patients
articles.summary: Blood tests that could spot the early signs of a range of the most common cancers are to be trialled on thousands of NHS patients.

articles.title: British Ebola case 'concerning, but not entirely unexpected'
articles.summary: A British citizen in the Democratic Republic of Congo has tested positive for Ebola and will be brought back to the UK for treatment.
